name: Penpot #11656 · nested component reset
objective: In a fresh test file, create a blue button component and an orange button component. Create a parent card component containing an intermediate group with a copy of the blue button inside it. Duplicate the parent card. In that copy, select the nested blue button, swap to the orange component, then right-click and Reset overrides. Expected: original blue component restored and the editor remains usable. Compare the same sequence without the intermediate group. The report mentions invalid-shape-id and missing swap slot. Only report what is observed.
notes: Unvalidated target template. Start Penpot, sign into a disposable test account, prepare a file URL, validate failure selectors and add a positive assertion for the restored original component.
